import sys
out, blk = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
lines = open(out, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
if lines[-1] == '': lines.pop()
for l in open(blk, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n'):
    if not l: continue
    n, en, pt = l.split('@@')
    assert lines[int(n)].split('\t')[0] == n
    lines[int(n)] = f"{n}\t{en}\t{pt}"
open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
EOF
